title: Integrate research agent with user review gate
userStory: As a developer, I want to review research findings before another planning iteration so that I control what feedback gets incorporated.
acceptanceCriteria: After planning iteration, research agent reviews output
Research agent produces: approval recommendation OR list of gaps
Gaps categorized: missing_story, edge_case, best_practice, security, accessibility, vague_criteria, error_handling
Gaps shown to user with severity and suggested fixes
User can: 'Accept All Feedback' -> triggers planning iteration
User can: 'Dismiss' individual gaps they disagree with
User can: 'Mark Ready' to override and skip more iterations
User can: 'Add My Own Feedback' with free-form input
Loop only continues when user triggers it
Research findings stored on task for visibility
